decision: Use meaningful concise alt descriptions for these five screenshot subjects in the article gallery. Empty alt currently hides useful UI examples; the gallery heading alone does not describe them.
reasoning: The atmospheric background/device frames and promotional slogans are decorative, but the screenshots show distinct calendar, forecast, Home Screen and Lock Screen layouts. A short subject description communicates the gallery purpose without transcribing sample appointments or repeating advertising copy. This is a contextual editorial assessment, not a formal compliance certification.

visualEvidence.observation: Angled dark day calendar with timed colored event blocks and a weather column. Marketing headline compares a meeting and rain.
Left portion of a two-image composition: cropped week calendar with multiple day columns and colored events.
Right continuation of partial week calendar beside a separate weather screen with temperature, hourly strip and daily forecast rows.

Two Home Screen device mockups display medium/large blue date, weather and event-list widgets. Some screenshot entries differ from current inspected native eligibility; do not turn sample contents into all-day eligibility claims.
Cropped Lock Screen next-event card shows event title, time, location and time-until-start.
Light iPad day calendar plus smaller dark iPhone day calendar, both with event blocks and weather.
A full light iPad week calendar beside a smaller dark iPhone week calendar. Main information is week layout, not a claim that every appointment fits.
Large iPad weather view and smaller iPhone weather view, showing hourly and daily forecasts. No week calendar in this rendition.
iPad Home Screen with two widget layouts and smaller iPhone Home Screen. Date, weather and event lists are visible.
iPad and iPhone Lock Screens each show a next-event card with time-until-start. Static image is not proof of ongoing update accuracy or every-device availability.

mapping.method: Remove the leading numeric ordinal and hyphen from manifest name, then exact match the complete remaining suffix.
mapping.rtl: ar-SA and he order live/widgets/week-right/week-left/hook; do not attach labels by array index.
mapping.scope: Five labels describe both inspected English device sets; labels omit device names because iPad images also depict iPhone. Other locales and future image replacements need corresponding verification.

implementationBoundaries: Use the label on the img alt; sources in picture do not need separate duplicate alternatives.
